cohort: The study included 256 Greek children (137 with learning difficulties diagnoses and 119 controls), whose mothers or parents responded to an online questionnaire.
finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with a 68% increased likelihood of learning difficulties, with higher risks for ADHD (OR = 2.25) and comorbid SLD/ADHD diagnoses (OR = 2.75).
mod_finding: Birthweight and gestational age were identified as effect modifiers, rather than confounders, in the association between CS delivery and learning difficulties.
